summary: Iteration 87 - MAARS Infinity Phase 2-4 Backend APIs and Frontend Pages tested. All 39 backend tests pass. Frontend pages for Observability, Commander Orion, Model Router, and Venture Portfolio all load correctly and function as expected. Real DuckDuckGo search integration verified. MAARS Infinity sidebar navigation section working.

phase1_system_status.details: GET /api/infinity/system/status returns operational status with 459 agents, 28 networks

phase2_working_memory_crud.details: All 4 Working Memory endpoints tested: store, get, append, delete - all work correctly

phase2_episodic_memory.details: All 4 Episodic Memory endpoints tested: record, recall by agent, collective recall, get lessons - all work

phase2_knowledge_graph.details: All 5 Knowledge Graph endpoints tested: add entity, add relationship, get entity, query graph, get stats

phase2_intelligence_search_duckduckgo.details: Real DuckDuckGo search integration working: POST /api/infinity/intelligence/search returns live search results

phase2_intelligence_search_plan.details: Query planning endpoint POST /api/infinity/intelligence/search/plan generates multiple search queries

phase2_verify_sources.details: Source verification endpoint POST /api/infinity/intelligence/verify-sources cross-references claims

phase2_intelligence_monitors.details: All 4 Monitor endpoints tested: create, get, run (with real search), get alerts

phase2_citations.details: Citation endpoints POST and GET work correctly with confidence and verification status

phase2_tool_registry.details: All 4 Tool Registry endpoints tested: register, get tools, record call, get health

phase3_commander_orion_execute.details: POST /api/infinity/orchestrator/execute creates goal, classifies, decomposes into task graph with 6 nodes

phase3_commander_classification.details: Goal classification works: research/engineering/marketing types detected correctly

phase3_commander_log.details: GET /api/infinity/orchestrator/log retrieves recent commander orchestration entries

phase4_venture_portfolio_crud.details: All venture endpoints work: create, get, update metrics, stage transition, get summary

phase4_venture_metrics_scoring.details: Opportunity scoring and recommended actions (scale/optimize/pivot/pause/kill) calculated correctly

router_performance.details: Model router routes tasks to appropriate models with cost/latency/tier selection

frontend_observability_dashboard.details: Observability Dashboard loads with stats grid, circuit breakers, router performance, trust leaderboard, commander log, audit trail, verification stats

frontend_commander_orion.details: Commander Orion page loads with goal input, env select, execute button. Goal execution returns result card with classification, task graph, reasoning

frontend_model_router.details: Model Router page loads with route input, route button. Task routing shows classification, selected model (perplexity/sonar-pro), latency/cost metrics, history

frontend_venture_portfolio.details: Venture Portfolio loads with portfolio summary (5 ventures, $100K revenue, $70K costs, 38 avg score), create form, venture cards with metrics and actions

frontend_sidebar_maars_infinity.details: MAARS Infinity section visible in sidebar with links to Observability, Model Router, Commander Orion, Venture Portfolio

critical_code_review_comments: All MAARS Infinity Phase 2-4 APIs have real implementations (no mocks)
DuckDuckGo search integration working with caching and source ranking
Commander Orion classification uses keyword matching - order matters due to elif
Frontend pages properly use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for all API calls
data-testid attributes present on all key UI elements for testing
seed_data_creation: Created test data with TEST_ prefix for Working Memory, Episodic Memory, Knowledge Graph, Monitors, Citations, Tools, Ventures during API testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 87 tested all MAARS Infinity Phase 2-4 features: Working Memory CRUD, Episodic Memory, Knowledge Graph, Intelligence Search (real DuckDuckGo), Intelligence Monitors, Citations, Tool Registry, Commander Orion orchestration, Venture Portfolio with metrics/scoring. All APIs use real implementations. Frontend pages (Observability, Commander, Model Router, Venture Portfolio) accessible from MAARS Infinity sidebar section.
